ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with high-intensity (white) regions concentrated at the distal tips; estimated macro-level ratio of 85:15 black to white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches located at the lateral distal extremities. Left lobe tip features a contiguous white band. Right lobe tip contains a white patch with internal low-intensity black circular spots. Sparse, high-intensity point clusters are distributed across the central black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys ranges from 5 to 20 pixels, creating a jagged boundary profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, terminating in sharp points at the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular pixel clusters (1-5 pixels diameter) distributed across the dark ventral surface, notably concentrated on the medial-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct high-intensity curvilinear mark approximately 150 pixels in length located on the right lobe, oriented medially to laterally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white curvilinear scratch on the right lobe and irregular, asymmetrical notch patterns along the trailing edge indicative of physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique internal mottling within the white patch of the right distal tip where low-intensity pixels form a 'leopard-spot' pattern.
